name: Synthesia
summary: AI video platform that creates avatar-led training, comms and marketing videos in 140+ languages.
description: Synthesia is an AI video communications platform for enterprise L&D, enablement, HR and internal-comms teams: turn scripts, PowerPoints, documents or prompts into videos with AI avatars and voiceovers in 140+ languages. Roleplay and Survey Sessions use interactive avatars to coach staff and interview customers, AI dubbing localizes existing footage with lip-sync, and the Interactive Avatars API embeds live avatars in products. Enterprise controls cover SCORM/LMS export, brand kits, SSO and SOC 2 Type II compliance.
contains: AI video creation from scripts, PowerPoint, documents, links or prompts
AI avatars: 125+ to 240+ stock, custom and personal avatars from a photo
Roleplay and Survey Sessions: avatar-led practice, interviews and coaching
video translation and dubbing into 140+ languages with lip-sync and voice cloning
Interactive Avatars API; MCP for Claude and ChatGPT
SCORM/LMS export, branded video pages, built-in analytics, PPT-to-video
free Basic plan with watermark; Starter $29/mo; Pro $89/mo; Enterprise custom
SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001/27701/42001, GDPR, EU data residency; 90% of Fortune 100
